Since October 2026 abuse.ch only gives this list with your own free key (for personal, non-commercial use).

1. On your phone or computer open auth.abuse.ch.
2. Choose »Sign in with Google« (or X, LinkedIn, GitHub, or »Email me a sign-in link«).
3. On your profile page create an Auth-Key and copy it here.

The key stays encrypted on this device only.
